Package org.saidone.protoalf.bulkexporter

package org.saidone.protoalf.bulkexporter
Reusable export utilities built on the protoalf Java service clients.

BulkExporter writes repository folders, metadata and historical document content in the Alfresco Bulk Filesystem Import layout. Applications supply service clients or a shared channel, ticket provider and deadline. This module has no dependency on Spring, MCP or the Alfresco platform runtime. Callers own the channel and decide when and where an export runs.

  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    BulkExporter
    Exports the content of a repository folder in the layout read by the Alfresco Bulk Filesystem Import Tool: one file or directory per document or folder, named as in Alfresco; next to each one a <name>.metadata.properties.xml shadow file (Java XML properties) with type, aspects and the properties, names in prefix:local form; the previous versions of a document as <name>.v1, <name>.v2, ... oldest first, with their shadow files <name>.metadata.properties.xml.v1, ...: the file without suffix is the current version.
    BulkExporter.Progress
    Counters and errors of an export.
